doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9 (comments, FBL 0.11), FR-001: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/trailing-comments.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. A comment trails every kind of statement and is read as no part of it: '(market)' inside the comment after Kettle is no decorator, and the url definition's address is https://example.com/grid.owm whole, since the address is one token that starts before the // of the scheme and runs past it, so the comment terminal is never a candidate there. 'pipeline Kettle // after a pipeline' with { on the next line owns that block. A set of the link's context and of the address-bearing submap's coordinates keeps each comment.

steps.doc: The context is replaced alone; '// after a context' stays.
steps.expect:
title Trailing comments // after the title
anchor User [0.95, 0.5] // after an anchor
component Kettle [0.5, 0.4] inertia // (market) inside a comment
component Power [0.1, 0.7] (build) // after a decorator
submap Grid [0.2, 0.8] url(gridMap) // after a url reference
url gridMap [https://example.com/grid.owm] // after an address with a scheme
User->Kettle // after a link
Kettle->Power; it runs on power // after a context
evolve Kettle 0.7 // after an evolve
note A note [0.3, 0.3] // after a note
pipeline Kettle // after a pipeline
{
    component Electric [0.6] // after a pipeline component, indented by four
}
